name: tracker-never-auto-launch
goal: Prove an explicit per-item auto-launch opt-out survives temporary pause expiry without changing flags, reminders or manual launch

evidence: The #485 temporary pause expires at schedule_off journal time plus 24 hours. Operators need a durable per-item hold with no next step and unchanged flag and reminder delivery.
Extend existing scheduler/idle, hold evaluation, schema replay and host reminder cases to prove the durable setting across the expiry boundary, an explicit clear and ordinary notifications.
